title: Mallworld: A soon to be verified natural phenomena.
content: Mallworld has shifted my consciousness in ways I'm not sure are postive or negative. But investigation is unavoidable at this point, after my stumbling upon the subject. I'm totally ambivalent and intrigued. A little scared and superstitious. Locked in and a little obsessed already. I was neglected for most of my childhood and fatherless until I was 8, my mother left me to figure it all out on my own as she drown her truma in booze and promiscuity. My father had zero interest in raising me until he met my stepmother. She wanted another child, as her first and only son was almost a man. She found purpose in taking care of people. I mention her because she told me about fascinating subjects. From Walt Disney to American history. She was my own personal precursor to the internet. Depression and anxiety have ruined so much of my life. I've always felt like a misfit or weirdo or freak because of it. When I eventually found out that I was those labels, I had to learn to mask it. For it was essential as I got older and started having children. Children that I shouldn't of had. Finding ways to conform and maybe even faking it enough to fit in and keep a job. The possibility of finding purpose through this masking wasn't even a concern for most of my life cause I was more interested in fooling employers and coworkers into thinking I was normal enough to keep around. Of course I wanted real connection. But even my friends were creeped out by my disposition and thought processes. Dreams and visions have always provided a narrative of escape for the realty I was saddled with. But I never found a group or person that I could connect to about it.That is, in a way that felt meaningful. Closest I came to that feeling so far was when I turned 27 and found out about 'synchromysticism'. Too which I lost myself in for several years. I even helped write a book about it that's still available on Amazon. I don't receive proceeds from it so I'm not plugging it. But much like that book is up on the shelf, so is my fascination in that subject. Since my love fizzled out around 2013, I've been a spiritual orphan of sorts. Afloat on a rickety raft I made from a hodge podge of subjects half assed learned. From Chaos Magik to quantum physics. I haven't really grasped anything to the point of being able to explain it without sounding like I'm full of it. So Mallworld comes up on tik tok yesterday. I have been watching video after video since. Trying to spawn in when I sleep. With a little success I'll elaborate on later on. But i already feel I have enough personal date to share that might help the cause. For example, I remember the GATE program in school. The crocodile shaped pink pills. The pink fluoride drink swish. The headset machines. Luckily I wasn't gifted or talented! But there are clues present in this aspect of the phenomena. I have already found out a friend of mine was in GATE. Asking her questions as I find the right ones to ask. So I'll be fleshing out this aspect as I go along. But let's get into my personal experiences in raw form. As a child I had a reoccurring dream of driving in a huge parking lot with a series of simple shaped brick buildings that didn't make sense. The painted lines on the pavement didn't really make sense either. It was bright during the day. Those dreams were in a car driving. I was in the back seat. I remember wanting to go into the buildings. But that didn't happen until later in life. But those dreams all felt in the same place. It gets blurry until about 2014 when I had a profound dream. A dream the crossed into the real world. It was inside a school. Starting out with me hiding behind debris. I peered through an opening and saw three guards(?). They were human in proportion but demons of fhe flesh. They were pale. Their eyes were black and small. Their skin seemed to be dripping transparent clear goo. Smiling menacingly. When the coast was clear I attempted to try find an exit. Semi lucid I slowly moved out into the corridor. I could hear little creatures laughing and scurrying like rats. They were little people. Not dwarves. But small demonic children. Laughing and taunting me. I remember getting very angry cause I couldn't see them. Best I could see was one little foot poking out as it ran around the next corner in front of me. I chased them down a maze of turns. Lockers and boarded up doorways. Everything broken. The lighting terrible. But fluorescent. Just when I thought I was close to catching one. I would just catch a glimpse of a foot. Angrier and angrier I got as I chased. Eventually I came to the gymnasium/playground? There were make shift walls that I ended up breaking through like the Kool-aid man. On the other side of the wall was darkness and a bunch of them laughing and making rat noises. I woke. At the time I was living in my mother's creepy basement in a haunted house(another story). Before I came Upstairs for the day I felt the need to watch a funny show after that crazy dream. It was louis ck show 'Louie', the dream episode called 'untitled'. 5th episode season 5. The episode started off normal. Making you feel at ease then BAM !! CREEPY DEMON JUMP SCARE!!! The first one was scary. But they kept doing it. Setting you up for calm then BAM!! The creepy thing plunging towards the camera. Then I noticed... the thing looked exactly like the demons from my dream! All the hair on my body stood on end. I turned off the TV and left the light on and bolted upstairs to sit in the living room with my sister. I was trembling. The next dream I remember was in 2020. It was in the 'INFINITY TOILET/LOCKERROOM'. Refer to slide 5 for the entry. Slide 1 is a rendering of the place. I wrote the dream down after waking from it. Doesn't make a lot of sense. But the key elements are there. Weird shower toilets, filth, wetness. That was that dream. As a side note: When I was little I think I had toilet warp dreams but I can't clearly remember. I'm trying to remember approximate dates. Looking for more journal entries. I had dreams being in this City which for a while I thought might be Chicago. But as of the last 24 hours am thinking maybe San Francisco or some bay city. I been to the AUDITORIUM. With the STEEP SEATING. It seemed to be in a tall building downtown. I remember exploring it. Feeling I was mostly alone. But also feeling like I didn't want to be caught by guards. I feel the hotel was close to the auditorium. Back to the MALLWORLD I first elaborated on with this post. As I got older, I got closer to the mall. Eventually getting to explore it. This mall was like 1980s/1990s malls. With sections to it. With +15 walkways connecting certain parts of it. I remember returning almost lucid and getting excited cause it felt real and familiar. Going back to places to see if they were still there. I remember TRAIN PLATFORMS. Traveling parts of this city. Usually anxious on these trains. Like I took the wrong one. Like I was stuck at certain locations. Sometimes no train would show up. I remember a SCARY MANSION that was vast inside but devoid of floors. Like a warehouse on the inside, old mansion on the outside.Full of stuff. But Iike hoarders. You couldn't drive a forklift in. But there was this feeling I had been there many times before but was just discovering there were hidden other huge rooms behind walls of stuff. But the most recent dream of note was by far the longest visit. Very strange I warn you now, reader. I think it was about 2 years ago? I'm sure I wrote about it. So I'm looking for it. But this is the last thing I'll write for now. It starts out in locker rooms. INFINATE LOCKER ROOMS. Normal ceilings. Fluorescent lighting. I was looking to make sense of it and get home. I felt like I was in another dimension. So I explored. Somehow I met my first inhabitant. Can't remember how. But he was very weird looking. Like the black and white Chad guy with dark hair. I made a rendering in the images slide 6. Anyways we were in this locker room talking about our problems. He would help me integrate in this world. Until I found a way home. But he wanted my help. I was going to help him find a lover. Using weird clunky tablet. Somehow I knew how to use software in this place. I entered his stats and filled out descriptions and sold him, as it were. I rember feeling grossed out cause this whole place was gross and wet and the things this guy wanted to do with his future lover made me very uncomfortable. I had a feeling he wanted to do those things with me. But I kept my cool. Somehow we ended up in a flower shop or gift store. He was trying to get me a job. I noticed the business connected to another business. Without a door. It was just open between the two. Maybe it was a fast food place. Anyways we ended up walking through a neighborhood that felt like Haight-Ashbury. I was in a house alone. And I woke up. I lost a lot of details about that dream. But the gross washrooms. I just know its the place you all are talking about. Except last night I had a dream I was watching a horror movie. About a guy in a really fancy mansion. Like 1980s fancy. There was a dial on the wall. A timer. The guy was white, balding with glasses. Kinda timid looking. He turned the timer on and pushed it in. All these automated functions began. It was strange cause lots of big things started moving and shifting. Like tall pillars and walls and mirrors. Rotating and spinning. Robotic vacuum cleaners and other single program basic robots started enganging in function. I had the feeling that buy the time the timer was complete, everyone in the house would be killed and cleaned up. I didn't get to see the 'movie' end. But I knew how it was going to end. I saw the robot vacuum approaching rhe smiling man as the scene faded and I woke up. First thing I did was go on tik tok and 'MALLWORLD' scroll until I came here and started exploring. Thank you for reading this. I'm going to end it here for now. I don't have a clue what to do now. Except maybe riff off any comments. Does anyone want to tell me more about infinity washrooms? Has anyone ever met a companion there?
